verses.1: A Psalm by the sons of Korah; a Song. His foundation is in the holy mountains.
verses.2: The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
verses.3: Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God. Selah.
verses.4: I will record Rahab and Babylon amongst those who acknowledge me. Behold, Philistia, Tyre, and also Ethiopia: “This one was born there.”
verses.5: Yes, of Zion it will be said, “This one and that one was born in her;” the Most High himself will establish her.
verses.6: The LORD will count, when he writes up the peoples, “This one was born there.” Selah.
verses.7: Those who sing as well as those who dance say, “All my springs are in you.”
